episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchors a two-hour broadcast covering the Israeli pager attacks in Lebanon and Abercrombie & Fitch sex crime allegations, interrupted by Hype Train's Austin Powers freestyle and a chaotic interview with wizard Henry Pottermore. The crew rates internet videos from a bear-mauling dip commercial to a 1968 car dealership tirade, learns dubious life skills from Jeb and his wood-trapped father, and concludes with a Jumbalaya panel where all guests — including Grandma Crumble Bottom — admit to wetting the bed more than seven times.
